Hello, and thank you for the review. Answers to your questions are below; they are also in the Notes field of App Review Information.

1. Screen recording: attached to this reply (the same file is under App Review Information, Attachment). It shows launch, the guided first level, a story scene, level 2, and the shop with the Atelier Club subscription (title, length, price, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links). It was recorded in the iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.5) from a Release build of the submitted code. To record without a person at the device, a small script added only to that recording build plays the taps; the white circle marks each tap. The game itself is unchanged. The clip is trimmed at the end and not otherwise edited. Tapping a plan opens Apple's standard StoreKit sign-in sheet; no Apple Account is signed in on the Simulator, so the recording ends there.
2. Purpose and audience: Gem Atelier is a relaxing gem-sorting puzzle game for adults and teens who enjoy casual brain teasers. Players sort gems between trays (four of a kind seals a tray) to restore their grandmother's jewellery shop and collect ten legendary gems. It offers a calm, no-timer puzzle with a light story.
3. How to use: no setup or login. Launch the app, tap Play on the map, tap a tray to lift its top gems and tap another tray to drop them. The Atelier, Journal, League and Daily buttons are on the map screen.
4. External services: Apple StoreKit (all payments), RevenueCat (validates and restores purchases; no personal data beyond an anonymous app user ID), Google AdMob (ads; personalised only if the player allows tracking in the App Tracking Transparency prompt). No login, no accounts, no user-generated content, no AI services, no other servers. The game runs fully offline except for ads and purchases.
5. Regional differences: none. The game works the same in every country where it is offered (all App Store countries except the EU).
6. Regulated industry or third-party material: not applicable. All art, music, characters and text are original.
7. In-app purchases: open the shop by tapping the coin counter at the top of the map or level screen. Remove Ads ($0.99, non-consumable), Starter Case ($2.99, non-consumable: coins, extra trays, hints and no ads), Rescue Kit ($0.99, consumable hints), coin packs 1,000 to 20,000 coins ($1.99 to $19.99, consumable), Atelier Club auto-renewing subscription ($4.99/month or $29.99/year: no ad breaks, +50% coins, 300 free coins a day, an exclusive theme). Restore purchases is in the shop and in Settings.

If you need the recording made on a physical device instead of the Simulator, please tell us and we will send one.
